# SeekFree dependency

This directory contains the small SeekFree configuration library used by the current MSPM0G3507 template:

```text
zf_device_config.lib
```

It is committed as a normal file, not a symbolic link, so users can clone the repository and build without copying the full SeekFree library tree.

The original SeekFree MSPM0G3507 open-source library states that it is licensed under GPL 3.0. If you redistribute this project publicly, keep the original copyright notices in related SeekFree-derived files and follow the upstream license requirements.
